evidence.title: Software di monitoraggio industriale OT e IT | Meddle

name: Meddle Connect
summary: Industrial monitoring software that connects PLCs, sensors, ERP and MES and answers energy, downtime and OEE questions in plain language.
description: Web platform that reads OT data (PLCs, OPC-UA, S7, Modbus, MQTT) and IT data (ERP, MES, SQL databases) into one key-value model and turns it into OEE, energy cost and anomalies. Users ask questions in Italian or English and get a number, a chart and a suggested action; worksheets refresh themselves and agents can write setpoints back to machines with approval. Cloud, on-premise or hybrid; data in Europe, NIS-2 ready.
contains: 44 connector types: OPC-UA, Siemens S7, Modbus, MQTT, SQL, ERP, MES and more
plain-language chat on energy, downtime, OEE, scrap and stop costs, in Italian or English
answers become self-updating worksheets and charts
agents write setpoints to machines with role-based approval and an audit trail
no-code canvas editor for data flows
cloud, on-premise or hybrid deployment; data in Europe; NIS-2 ready
